_comment: First-run configuration. Everything the extension ships with lives here so
it can be edited without touching code — change a value, reload the
extension, and hit 'Reset everything to defaults' in settings to adopt it
(existing saved settings are not overwritten by a reload).
path:   optional, scopes a rule to part of a site, e.g. '/shorts'
always: true gates around the clock; set false to use days/from/until
wait/unlock on a rule: null means 'use the level preset'
